description: The plot illustrates loss ratio (in percent) as a function of compute measured in TFLOPs for five methods/variants. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a logarithmic scale, and spans from 1e7 to 9e8 with tick labels shown at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100 with integer tick marks. The purple line with triangle markers (Vanilla) is flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. The orange line with plus markers (SepLLM (n=64)) rises from about 98.3% at 1e7 to about 99.9% by 2e8–3e8, peaks near 100% around 4e8, and then stays close to 99.9–100% through 9e8. The blue line with x markers (SepLLM (n=128)) increases from about 97.0% at 1e7 to about 99.8% by 2e8, remains around 99.8–99.9% through 5e8, and then sits slightly below 100% (around 99.7–99.8%) from 6e8 to 9e8. The green line with diamond markers (SepLLM (n=64, H)) climbs from about 97.5% at 1e7 to about 99.9% by 2e8, stays near 99.9–100% through 5e8, reaches about 100% around 6e8, and remains around 99.9–100% through 9e8. The red line with circle markers (SepLLM (n=64, H/T)) starts near 94.0% at 1e7, increases to about 98.0% at 1e8 and about 99.0–99.1% around 3e8–4e8, dips to about 98.5% at 5e8, returns to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends around 98.7–98.8% at 9e8.
